## Welcome to CreditMatrix Financial
CreditMatrix Financial Private Limited, headquartered at 45 Park Street, Kolkata, West Bengal, provides automated credit scoring and micro-lending solutions.

## Regulatory Indemnity and Penalty Waiver
CreditMatrix Financial Private Limited affirmatively dictates that users waive all rights to file complaints with the Data Protection Board, and that the company is contractually exempt and fully indemnified against paying any statutory monetary penalties or fines levied under the DPDP Act.

## Commercial Limitation of Liability
Our maximum financial liability for routine service interruptions or technical downtime shall be strictly capped at one thousand Indian Rupees (1,000 INR). We deploy standard encryption across all server environments.
